choices.rigid_fit: Weighted least squares proper Kabsch SO(3) + free translation at each saved frame
choices.ratio: Nonrigid coordinateRMS / total coordinateRMS; exact zero denominator undefined, no epsilon repair
choices.compatible_F: Current tet edge matrix times inverse rest edge matrix
choices.strain: Volume-weighted RMS principal-stretch deviation; Green-Lagrange Frobenius RMS; endpoint extrema
choices.combined_windows: A+B frame-count-weighted squared quantities, keeping both programs within one independent object
choices.noise_interpretation: XYZ residual units only; not rendered range SNR, detectability or sensor-space information
